summary: ArcelorMittal filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release for the period ended September 30, 2026. Results show EBITDA of $2.0 billion (+34% year-on-year) and EBITDA per tonne of $155, with an adjusted net income of $0.9 billion ($1.15 EPS) against a reported net loss of $0.4 billion that included impairment and exceptional charges tied to idling the Kryvyi Rih (Ukraine) operations. Net debt rose to $10.3 billion, liquidity was $8.7 billion, and $1.1 billion was returned via dividends and buybacks. No transactional special situation is disclosed; watch European trade measures and working-capital unwind.
